claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Low-energy regime contains SM with one complex Higgs doublet, two higgsino Weyl doublets and gluino/wino/bino. Squarks,sleptons and second heavy Higgs are integrated out, not simultaneously counted as light matter. Matching to MSSM is a relation between regimes.

limitations: This is a complete low-energy EFT gauge-matter specification, not the full heavy-threshold MSSM spectrum or a SUSY-breaking UV completion.
